metadata.description: Google Slides deck generation: template-driven, from-scratch, Scalar product and proposal workflows, plus draw.io diagrams, on a shared Python engine with visual QA

plugins.name: slide-forge
plugins.description: Generate Google Slides decks with Python + the Slides API. Five skills on one shared engine: google-slides-template (generate from a registered master template with interactive intake, spec validation, and thumbnail-based visual QA), google-slides (from-scratch decks via a blank template spec path or a code-first deckkit path with offline layout validation), scalar-product-slides (Scalar Inc. company/product deck workflow), scalar-proposal-slides (customer-challenge-driven Scalar solution proposals with challenge-to-product mapping, 3-environment architecture diagrams, and a BOM with quantities and monthly costs), and drawio-diagrams (dense cloud architecture / data-flow diagrams authored as draw.io files and exported to PNG headlessly). Includes charts, business-framework figures, pictogram and cloud-vendor icon libraries, AI image generation, and parallel per-page spec authoring for large decks.
